requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:644-650 serve `view('auth.login')` / `view('auth.register')`, views not in the diff; the Livewire components are never routed. app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:184 imports nonexistent `Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str`, so `Str::lower` (line 204) is a fatal error. VerificationController.php:139 calls `Auth::findUserById`, which does not exist. No `Password::defaults()`, no password rule (Register.php:257, ResetPasswordController.php:94). The register limiter is never hit (Register.php:265-280) and is not transliterated. No .env.example or phpunit.xml changes. verification.verify has no throttle (web.php:681).

conventions.evidence: No tests at all, against the mandatory TDD rule. Livewire uses `rules()` and not `#[Validate]` (Login.php:192, Register.php:252). The Livewire views use `@extends`/`@section` and have no single root element (login.blade.php:534). Bulma loads from a CDN in layouts/app.blade.php:515. Form markup is repeated, with no Blade components. No CHANGELOG or docs updates. Unused imports in every class.

security.evidence: Registration rate limiting does nothing: `RateLimiter::hit` is never called (Register.php:265-281). There is no password strength rule on register or reset (Register.php:257, ResetPasswordController.php:94). The verification link has no throttle (web.php:681). Login regenerates the session and clears the limiter correctly (Login.php:212-213). Reset rotates remember_token (ResetPasswordController.php:102). The verify id check compares with `!==` against the logged-in user (VerificationController.php:144). Output is escaped with {{ }}.

tests.evidence: The diff has no test files: no feature or Pest tests for login, register, reset, verification, localization, unauthorized calls or tampering.

simplicity.evidence: Controllers are short. There is leftover noise, though: an unused `$status` (ForgotPasswordController.php:30), unused imports of nonexistent classes (ResetPasswordController.php:72-74), and a duplicate key `verification.sent` next to `verification_link_sent` (lang/en/ui.php:341-342).

readability.evidence: VerificationController.php:144-153 has broken indentation. There are many unused or invalid imports (ResetPasswordController.php:72-74, LogoutController.php:46, Login.php:181-183) and missing final newlines. Translation keys mix styles (`verification.sent` vs `verification_link_sent`).

scope.evidence: All files serve the auth task. The CDN Bulma link in layouts/app.blade.php:515 adds a frontend dependency path the task does not ask for, and it bypasses the existing asset pipeline.

issues.explanation: The login and register routes return nonexistent views `auth.login`/`auth.register` and do not mount the Livewire full-page components, so both pages fail.
`Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str` does not exist, so `Str::lower` on line 204 throws a class-not-found error on every login attempt.
`Auth::findUserById` is not a guard or AuthManager method, so every verification link errors and verification cannot work.
The change ships no tests, which breaks the mandatory TDD convention and leaves every requirement unverified.
The register limiter is checked but never hit, so registration is unthrottled. The key is also not built with `str()->transliterate(...)` as specified.
`Password::defaults()` is never configured and no `Password::defaults()` rule is applied on register or reset (ResetPasswordController.php:94), so weak passwords are accepted.
`.env.example` (APP_NAME/APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE) and the `phpunit.xml` locale pins are missing. Existing views are not checked for hardcoded hrefs.
The Livewire component views use `@extends` with no single root element instead of a component layout, which Livewire full-page components do not support.
The `verification.verify` route is signed but not throttled, although the task requires it to be throttled.
Validation uses a `rules()` method instead of the project's `#[Validate]` attribute pattern.
Bulma 0.9.4 loads from a CDN instead of the project's asset build.
There is no CHANGELOG or docs update. Repeated form-field markup is not extracted into Blade components.
These are unused imports of nonexistent classes. Other unused imports and broken indentation in VerificationController.php:144-153 add to the noise.
The `verification.sent` key duplicates `verification_link_sent` and is unused.

review.summary: The change adds auth controllers, Livewire Login/Register classes, Bulma views, ui translations and routes. It does not work: the login and register routes render nonexistent views instead of the Livewire components, Login fatals on a nonexistent `Str` facade, and verification calls a nonexistent `Auth::findUserById`. It ships no tests, skips the password default rule, the register throttling and the locale config, so it must be rejected.
